    right_beams = []
    for y in [2.5, 6.5]:
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x=13.5, y=y, width=beam_width, height=beam_height, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
        right_beams.append(b)

    # Connect left beams sequentially
    for i in range(len(left_beams) - 1):
        x_anchor = (left_beams[i].position.x + left_beams[i+1].position.x) / 2
        y_anchor = (left_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[i+1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[i], left_beams[i+1], (x_anchor, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect left beams to middle beam
    for beam in left_beams:
        if 3.25 <= beam.position.y <= 5.5:
            x_anchor = (beam.position.x + middle_beam.position.x) / 2
            y_anchor = (beam.position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
            sandbox.add_joint(beam, middle_beam, (x_anchor, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect middle beam to right beams
    for beam in right_beams:
        x_anchor = (middle_beam.position.x + beam.position.x) / 2
        y_anchor = (middle_beam.position.y + beam.position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, beam, (x_anchor, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect right beams to left beams for force distribution
    # Right beam at y=2.5 to left beam at y=3.25
    x_anchor = (right_beams[0].position.x + left_beams[3].position.x) / 2
    y_anchor = (right_beams[0].position.y + left_beams[3].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[0], left_beams[3], (x_anchor, y_anchor), type='rigid')
    # Right beam at y=6.5 to left beam at y=5.5
    x_anchor = (right_beams[1].position.x + left_beams[5].position.x) / 2
    y_anchor = (right_beams[1].position.y + left_beams[5].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[1], left_beams[5], (x_anchor, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Ensure all beams are within build strips
    for beam in left_beams:
        assert 12.4 <= beam.position.x <= 12.6, "Left beam x not in left strip"
    assert 12.9 <= middle_beam.position.x <= 13.1, "Middle beam x not in middle strip"
    for beam in right_beams:
        assert 13.4 <= beam.position.x <= 13.6, "Right beam x not in right strip"

    return left_beams[0]
